تستبون (form VIII)
# تَسْتَبُونَ (tastabūna) /tas.ta.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبَى (istabā)
# تُسْتَبَوْنَ (tustabawna) /tus.ta.baw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَبَى (istabā)
